name: alakazam_ml_v25
model: The v24 LightGBM action ranker, guarded live scope, and bounded card-ID-agnostic target ranker are byte-identical. v25 changes deterministic route accounting only.
model_scope: Hard rules own legality, wins, damage, KO, prize tiers, Boss use, Archaludon/Grimmsnarl pressure, Dudunsparce cycles and pivots, and every non-target decision. The inherited target model contributes at most +/-800 inside deterministic target value.

source_evidence.interpretation: Live v24 results overrule the old v25 one-step imitation gain. The rebuilt v25 keeps v24 behavior and changes only repeated cycle-accounting and pressure-release errors supported by both losing trajectories and top-agent actions.

v25_rule_changes: Evaluate Run Away Draw by the visible post-resolution deck size: draw up to three, then return the Dudunsparce evolution stack and attached public cards.
Permit a zero-card-deck Dudunsparce cycle when another board body remains and the returned evolution stack restores at least two deck cards.
Do not downgrade an immediate higher-prize Active KO solely for a Bench role bonus.
Keep an immediate or clean two-hit Archaludon ex route instead of gusting Cinderace or a substitute one-prizer, except for a terminal Boss win.
While a live Froslass remains, do not add the Grimmsnarl-board online-Munkidori bonus that previously reversed their target order.
removed_old_v25_rules: Post-KO blanket promotion of unfinished Alakazam-line bodies over Dudunsparce and Fezandipiti.
Mirror Fezandipiti suppression outside an immediate recovery window.
preserved_v24_invariants: v24 deck, action model, target model, and guarded ML live scope
terminal Boss and terminal Active win gates
v24 ex KO route, Grimmsnarl pressure, and low-deck pivot routes
Mist Energy Hammer memory and effect-prevention handling
Fezandipiti exposure, alternate-attacker, and Articuno-breaker logic
known_limitations: Teacher-forced comparison does not simulate the counterfactual trajectory after a changed action.
The local native battle API does not expose a fully deterministic RNG seed.
A recorded expert action is preference data, not proof of a unique globally optimal action.
Opening-hand variance and hidden information cannot be eliminated by deterministic routing.
A fresh live submission is required to validate rating stability.
